Now discrepancy in expected q0 p0 and q3 p0 and q4 p0: our actual NODATA, oracle NXDOMAIN. Let's examine.

Query x.a.test. Zone a.test. origin a.test. Records: x.a.test. TXT "x"; c.a.*.a.test AAAA; y.c.c.a.test CNAME. So x.a.test. exists exact because record owner x.a.test. TXT. Query A should NODATA, not NXDOMAIN. Our actual NODATA correct. Oracle returned NXDOMAIN. Why? Oracle build_zones existing? It starts existing={origin}, then for each record adds owner and ancestors. For owner x.a.test., existing should include x.a.test. Wait but the oracle in `build_zones` uses `n=o; while n!=origin: n=parent(n); existing.add(n)`. It does NOT add o itself! Ah oracle bug. Existing set must include record owner itself. In our implementation we add owner with existing.add(node) before loop. Oracle forgot. So fuzzer expected wrong. Need fix oracle existing add o.

content.text: The oracle itself had a bug (omitted owners from existing set). Fixing the fuzz oracle:

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='/workspace/tmp/fuzz.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("            n=o\n            while n!=origin:\n", "            n=o\n            existing.add(n)\n            while n!=origin:\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python3 /workspace/tmp/fuzz.py
